name: Sasseur Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: Sasseur Real Estate Investment Trust invests in a portfolio of real estate and related assets. The company operates through four segments: Sasseur (Chongqing Liangjiang) Outlet, Sasseur (Chongqing Bishan) Outlet, Sasseur (Hefei) Outlet, and (Sasseur (Kunming) Outlet. Its property portfolio comprises four retail outlet malls located in the People's Republic of China. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Singapore. Sasseur Real Estate Investment Trust operates as a subsidiary of Sasseur Cayman Holding II Ltd.
